FN-EV3H299-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 400
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Reed Ingram
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/09/2024
House Bill 400 as introduced proposes a Constitutional Amendment, which if ratified, would
allow the salary of a district attorney to be increased but not decreased during his or her term of
office.
This amendment could increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid from the State
General Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2025.
